question: Which of the following is the longest beach in the world?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Praia do Cassino Beach, Brazil**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Praia do Cassino (“Cassino Beach”) **is the **longest **beach in the world.
 
• The beach is located in the Southernmost Brazilian state of Rio Grande do Sul.
 
• It stretches over a length of **254** km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88366383fb12dcdea100eb9599ceaf6d684074cd3836a7803cc532a0809434c9.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Playa Novillero Beach, Mexico**

 
 
• ​Playa Novillero (Novillero Beach) is the seventh-longest beach in the world.
 
• The beach measures an impressive 82 km.
 
 
 
• **Padre Island, Texas**
 
 
• **​**It is the world's longest barrier island located along Texa's southern coast of the Gulf of Mexico.
 
• Its length; measures 182 km.
 
 
 
• **Cox’s Bazar Beach, Bangladesh**
 
 
• **​**Cox’s Bazar Beach is the** fourth longest beach in the world.**
 
• At the same time, the beach is the longest one in the Indian Ocean and in all of Asia.
 
• It is alongside the Himachari national park and measures 120 km.
 
 

f2:T
